info.name: MusicCurator
info.summary: Curate, tag and organize your Nextcloud music library
info.description:
MusicCurator helps you review and improve the metadata of audio files stored in Nextcloud. Compare existing tags with metadata-provider suggestions, choose changes field by field, organize files into album or playlist folders, and keep every destructive action behind a preview.
The project is designed as a companion for Nextcloud Music. MusicCurator manages the library; Nextcloud Music remains responsible for playback.
info.author: Happyfeet01
